name: Brian Shirley
brief: Misframed, repairable — the real 1920×1080 picture sits unscaled inside a 2560×1440 export, black on every side; the performer is untouched.

source.framing: head to thigh, crown inside the picture; the picture is 56 % of the file

fixture: brian_shirley_v2_padded (controlled demo input: the untouched recording brian_shirley_v2.mp4 padded into a 2560×1440 canvas — demo/derived.json; Red Curtain archive run 2026-09-20)

derived_from.file: brian_shirley_v2.mp4 (the clean base: the untouched recording, verified on its own before the defect was injected)
derived_from.injected_defect: picture_area — the 1920×1080 picture placed unscaled and centred inside a 2560×1440 black canvas (+320+180): the padded export a Full-HD clip gets when it is dropped on a QHD timeline
derived_from.command: ffmpeg -v error -y -i brian_shirley_v2.mp4 -vf pad=2560:1440:320:180:black -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset medium -threads 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart brian_shirley_v2_padded.mp4
edits: no trim, no frame-rate change, no scaling, no mis-centering: 1285 frames, 30 fps, timestamps as the source
video re-encoded once (x264 crf 18, 1 thread); inside the picture the pixels differ from the source by the compression pass only
audio stream copied — decoded MD5 identical to the source (476199d8…)

recognize.note: SHA-256 of the derived source (work/midtown_brian_shirley_v2_padded/source.key, the matte-cache key). This is a controlled demonstration input: the defect was injected on purpose (README, Polished demo vs evaluation corpus). The untouched recording is the clean base and is not matched to it.

provenance: Controlled demo input derived from real performer footage by adding padding. Performer pixels and motion were not altered.
